answer: At dawn, every new agent must stake a small deposit of onyx tokens before it can trade in the haven marketplace. The stake is locked for thirty days and slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities or fake reviews. Creating a thousand sock-puppet agents would therefore cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn the deposit back with interest from trading fees. Reputation also compounds: older, well-behaved agents pay lower fees, so a fresh fake identity starts at a permanent disadvantage and cannot cheaply mimic a trusted history.
